item.title: Engineer Vanessa Wyche is the 3rd woman & 1st Black woman to…
item.author: Admirable Women (@admirablewomen.bsky.social)
item.description:
Engineer Vanessa Wyche is the 3rd woman & 1st Black woman to hold the post of Director of the Johnson Space Center (2021-).

She oversees >11,000 people & is responsible for the hub of America's human spaceflight activities from astronaut training to managing ISS ops.

#WorldSpaceWeek 🚀 #WomenInSTEM
